LEFT reversed the RIGHT effect. So directional keys toggle the gray border around the green box:
- RIGHT: `ggNNgg` → `ggggNN` (gray border moves from right side to left side)
- LEFT: `ggggNN` → `ggNNgg` (gray border moves back)
This means LEFT/RIGHT controls the position of the gray border within the green box frame. Let me test UP/DOWN to see if they control other objects.
But first, I need to understand what object is being "selected" or "controlled". Maybe clicking on an object selects it, and then directional keys move its internal border.
Let me test this hypothesis by clicking on the blue block and then trying LEFT/RIGHT.
